provenance.status: development assumptions; not a qualified full-envelope Thor model
provenance.airframe_reference: Dorobantu et al., System Identification for Small, Low-Cost, Fixed-Wing Unmanned Aircraft; 32-page 2012 public manuscript, Table 1 and Eqs. 25/26
provenance.geometry_and_inertia: Table 1; body inertia off-diagonal xz is -ixz
provenance.aerodynamic_coefficients: Dimensionless reconstruction near 19 m/s, rho=1.225; derivation in docs/flight-model.md
unmeasured: drag polar and full-angle flat-plate extension
stall onset, separation/reattachment lag and post-stall control fractions
thrust acceleration, constant-power transition and engine time constant
servo time constant and rate limit
provenance.actuator_reference: First-order lag and position/rate limits are established simulation forms; our values are development assumptions, not NASA or Thor measurements
provenance.landing_gear: GroundContact.h development proxy: three fixed deployed contact points, 3 s retractable gear and Cd correction; separate from these numeric parameters, no measured Thor gear data
